meta.title: [PoC] Build tag for lightweight test build
meta.body_summary: PoC adding a 'lite' build tag to exclude heavy cloud dependencies (AWS SDK, GCP client, pgx) from test binary builds, achieving ~32% faster build time.

perf_labels.notes: Codex PoC with hyperfine benchmarks; self-closed without review after ~22h.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 565 changed lines across 49 files, this is a medium-sized build tag refactor by absolute volume. It fits a typical proof-of-concept optimization that was self-closed without merge.

review_details.concern_detail: No reviews or comments were recorded; the author closed the PR as a proof-of-concept without soliciting feedback.
review_details.performance_claim: 32% build time reduction for test binary by removing heavy cloud dependencies via build tag.
review_details.rejection_signals: Self-closed by author as PoC; no merge intent or external rejection.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Codex produced a working build-tag optimization with reproducible benchmarks, but the PR remained a proof-of-concept and was closed without maintainer review, indicating a process boundary where acceptance requires more than technical correctness.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes explicit hyperfine commands and shows 32% speedup; a verification script is provided.

core_change_summary.description: Added 'lite' Go build tag to exclude heavy cloud dependencies (AWS SDK, GCP client, pgx) from test binary builds, replacing them with stub implementations, and added a verification script. Build time reduced by ~32% (13.6s -> 9.3s).
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Majority of files had a single build tag line added; the new stub files provide no-op implementations.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added build tags and stub files for gcloud/s3store providers and pgx.
Second commit: added verification script check-lite-binary.sh.
Third commit: fixed up additional build tags for persistence client, elasticsearch AWS, and cassandra tools; renamed aws.go to add lite build tag.

collaboration_trajectory: Codex opened PR with build tag PoC and benchmarks.
Author added verification script and made several force pushes and rename to indicate PoC.
PR closed by author after ~22 hours with no review or discussion.
